text: {"lessons":["I have often sold winners quickly for the pleasure of locking in gains; I should base exits on my plan and the investment outlook, not that satisfaction alone.","I have sometimes bought back after selling and held losing positions because admitting a mistake is painful; I should reassess each stock objectively and avoid letting regret or my purchase price dictate decisions.","Frequent checking and short-term swings can tempt me to overtrade, while losses weigh heavily on me; I should keep risk appropriate for my age and make deliberate decisions rather than react to daily moves."]}
